final_claim.narrative: The neighbourhood_evolution probe with a 5000-unit half-window (step_01) found a peak dissimilarity of 1.0 at time 77986: the 'before' and 'after' contact sets are disjoint, exceeding the 0.6 threshold and indicating an abrupt replacement of partners. A volume check (step_02) shows activity dropped from 204 events in the left half-window to 89 in the right half-window; this confirms a change in activity level but does not explain the complete turnover of contact identities, so the abrupt regime switch conclusion stands.
